answer.title: How many files are in the study folder
What kinds of files are in the study folder

answer.none: The commands can read a file's text or a spreadsheet's columns, but they cannot report how many pages a PDF has.

answer.title: What the 2025 report is mostly about

answer.none: The commands can only list or read files, not folders, so they cannot show which folders you have.

answer.title: How fixity checking changed from 2021 to 2025

answer.none: The commands can read the 2021 and 2025 data files (FILE_2 and FILE_3), but they cannot draw or export a chart, so the answers-per-year chart itself can't be produced here.
